name: Nikutsubo JK
source:
After experiencing failure in fulfilling his dream to become a designer for clothing and being left with no other aspirations, our protagonist spends his days jobbing in a convenience store. If there can anything be called joyful in his life, then it is conversing with Suzuhara Moe, a student from a nearby refined girl's school. "But this peaceful life may not be all that bad," he thinks.

But abrupt change is imminent...

The convenience store he was working in, suddenly went bankrupt and had to close its doors.
With no prospects at a new job and despair at the frigidity that reigns in society, his eyes fall on Moe who's experiencing no hardships in life whatsoever.

Here, the protagonist who is sick of the unfairness with which the world treats its citizens, is struck with an idea: At the opportunity when the clock strikes for the post-exam holidays and the students have in mind is how much fun they are going to have on their respective vacation trips, he'll abduct one of the girl students into his house and indulge into her abuse.

You, as the protagonist will carry out the abduction of one of these sheltered refined girls who have never internalized that other people aren't to be trusted, will etch the mark of how cruel society can be into her immaculate body, reducing her to nothing else than what she is: Fuckmeat.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ007313.html/?unique_op=af]DLSite[/url]]
